additive_control: descriptive negative control, excluded from logistic robustness gates

adjacency.rule: one horizontal or vertical step in the declared 3x3 grid

depletion_diagnostic.use: descriptive; never an alternative route to passing consumption harm

failure_rule: halt and preserve the bank on unexpected engineering or data failure; no dropping/replacement of cases; adverse scientific outcomes are valid complete results
scope: Prospective finite-horizon qualification of two frozen local controllers and one supplied aggressive variant; no institutional or evolutionary claim.

statistics.method: Seed-level paired or single-condition Student-t intervals; two-sided Bonferroni union of 194 predeclared scalar intervals; approximate model-based coverage.
statistics.pass_rule: lower-bound endpoint: lower>=margin passes, upper<margin fails, otherwise unresolved; reverse inequalities for upper-bound endpoints; exact float comparison, no tolerance
